relations.text: Disneyの年次報告が、物理媒体の流通を第三者に許諾し、第三者がAmazonなどの小売に販売すると述べている
relations.text_en: Disney's annual report says it licenses physical distribution rights to third parties who sell to retailers such as Amazon

source.label: Disney 10-K
source.quote: We have licensed the rights for physical distribution to third parties who generally sell to retailers, such as Walmart and Amazon.

relations.text: Disneyの年次報告が、電子版をAmazonなどのe-tailer経由で配信すると述べている
relations.text_en: Disney's annual report says it distributes electronic formats through e-tailers such as Amazon

source.label: Disney 10-K
source.quote: We distribute electronic formats through e-tailers such as Apple and Amazon, and MVPDs, such as Comcast and DirecTV.

relations.text: Disneyの年次報告が、電子版をAppleなどのe-tailer経由で配信すると述べている
relations.text_en: Disney's annual report says it distributes electronic formats through e-tailers such as Apple

source.label: Disney 10-K
source.quote: We distribute electronic formats through e-tailers such as Apple and Amazon, and MVPDs, such as Comcast and DirecTV.

relations.text: Foxの年次報告が、21CFとDisneyとの関係を定める分離・配分契約を結んでいると述べている
relations.text_en: Fox's annual report says it is party to a separation and distribution agreement governing its relationship with 21CF and Disney

source.label: Fox Corporation 10-K
source.quote: The Company is party to a separation and distribution agreement and a tax matters agreement that govern certain aspects of the Company’s relationship with 21CF and Disney following the Disney Transaction.

relations.text: Foxの年次報告が、FOX SportsとDisney/ESPNをUFLの試合の国内配信パートナーとしている
relations.text_en: Fox's annual report names FOX Sports and Disney/ESPN as the domestic distribution partners of UFL games

source.label: Fox Corporation 10-K
source.quote: FOX Sports and Disney/ESPN are the domestic distribution partners of the UFL games under multi-year rights agreements.

relations.text: Disneyの2026年2月の発表が、OpenAIとの提携を挙げている
relations.text_en: Disney's February 2026 press release cites the partnership just announced with OpenAI

source.label: Disney 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: “I’m confident Disney will continue to innovate and put the spirit of Walt at the heart of everything it does – from its new park in Abu Dhabi to the groundbreaking partnerships just announced with OpenAI and the NFL, to the countless upcoming creative projects that will enthrall audiences around the world.

relations.text: OpenAIがSoraを終了したため、Disneyは予定していた同社への投資を行わない
relations.text_en: Because OpenAI shut down Sora, Disney will not proceed with its previously planned investment in the company

source.label: Disney 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: As widely reported, OpenAI opted to shut down Sora, and as a result we will not proceed with our previously planned investment in the company.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
